name: Top Systems Data Center Burgas
notes: Top Systems official site describes the Burgas data center (planned 2026 opening, 2.5 MW, ~1,200 sq m, 220 racks, 100% renewable ambition, 10 MW/5,000 sq m expansion target); DataCenterHawk and Datacenters listings place the facility in Burgas. ESO data reported by Economic.bg (2026-08-12) show ~1.86 GW of declared data-center grid-connection interest in Burgas province.

name: VueNow Burgas edge data center
notes: 2021 DCD report on the VueNow MoU for up to seven Bulgarian edge data centers named Burgas among initial locations; per BG methodology this is a stale MoU lead (C) unless refreshed by permits/operator evidence, which was not found.

name: AC DC / AbsCloud Green Data Center Varna
notes: Official AC DC / AbsCloud pages describe a fully renewed Tier III green data center in Varna offering colocation and cloud services; directory listing confirms Varna location.

name: Varna Data Center
notes: Official Varna Data Center site (8-Mi Primorski Polk Blvd 128) presents an operating independent high-tech colocation/data center project started in 2011.

name: Evolink Data Center Varna
notes: Evolink Bulgarian official page states the company built and operates four data centers in Sofia, Plovdiv and Varna, adding Varna as a named Evolink location; individual Varna facility spec sheet not published, so capacity is unverified.

name: VueNow Varna edge data center
notes: 2021 VueNow MoU named Varna among planned Bulgarian edge data centers; stale lead per BG methodology, no construction/permit evidence found.

name: VueNow Kyustendil-region edge data center
notes: 2021 VueNow MoU named the region around Kyustendil among initial Bulgarian edge locations; stale MoU lead (C) per BG methodology, no later buildout evidence.

name: Telepoint Montana Data Center
notes: Telepoint official site and DataCenterMap identify the Telepoint carrier-neutral data center at 78 Treti Mart Blvd, Montana; Digital Realty's 2026 acquisition announcement names only two Sofia data centers, so Montana is treated as a Telepoint regional facility verified via operator contact/directory (capacity not stated). ESO data (Economic.bg, 2026-08-12) show ~970 MW declared data-center grid-connection interest in Montana.

name: Neterra Pazardzhik
notes: Aggregator listings identify an operational Neterra colocation/data-center facility in Pazardzhik; no primary operator facility page found, so grade C per BG methodology.
